'''SD-0''' was the designation of a [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droid]] located on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] around [[3643 BBY]], when it was destroyed.

==Behind the scenes==
SD-0 appears in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' as a Champion boss on Coruscant. This article assumes 100% game completion, which means it was destroyed.
